segments.name: F-104 Fighter jets
segments.description: Operates fighter jets for pilot training, flight testing and launch services, and develops orbital launch infrastructure for commercial, defense and government clients.
segments.evidence: Our Chief Executive Officer, who is our chief operating decision maker, views the Company's operations and manages its business in one operating segment, which is principally the operations of F-104 Fighter jets and development of infrastructure for orbital space launch.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay for pilot training and in-flight testing services, which produced most of the company's income historically.
revenueModel.evidence: Historically, Starfighters generated the majority of its income from its Historical Services of pilot training and in-flight testing, and continues to do so today.
